title: [CQ-R11e] Guest check toolchain
description:
Gap found while splitting CQ-R11 (2026-10-29). Filed for a human decision, like CQ-R10d.

The pinned Ubuntu 24.04 guest ships python3 but no Node, npm or project dependencies. A fresh check VM therefore cannot run this repository's real checks, e.g. `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test`. CQ-R11a-d and CQ-R11 prove the check lifecycle with python3 stdlib check commands. CQ-R13 needs this row to certify real checks.

Objective: a fresh check VM can run a project's approved check commands with a pinned toolchain and the candidate's locked dependencies, without trusting the network for code identity. Options to decide:
- a pinned toolchain bundle (node and npm) copied in root-owned 0555 and sha256-pinned next to the image pins, e.g. a copy-only supervisor stream like R09c materialize;
- a separate, network-enabled dependency install phase from the candidate's lockfile, run before the network-namespaced check, with its own outcome. A failed install is infra-failure, never code-failure;
- vendored or offline dependency caches.
Whatever is chosen becomes part of CQ-R11d's environment identity (a toolchain digest input), so a toolchain change requires new evidence.

Expect a SPIDR split when planned: the toolchain bundle and its pinning; the dependency phase; and their identity inputs.

Out of scope: the check mode itself (CQ-R11a/b), the session (CQ-R11c), the lifecycle (CQ-R11), and any verified-local or isolation claim.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs
definitionOfDone: The toolchain is verified against its pinned sha256 before install and installed root-owned, not writable by job identities; a mismatch fails closed.
Dependencies reach the check only through the decided, bounded path. A failed dependency phase is reported as infra-failure, never as code-failure or passed.
The toolchain identity is an input of CQ-R11d's checkEnvironment, so a toolchain change makes earlier evidence stale. Shown by tests.
The verification command exits 0, and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
TESTS FIRST (red). Load test-driven-development.

This row was split on 2026-10-30. Its guest and host pieces live in CQ-R11e1..e5 (tasks b799056d, 1e7f5a2d, ab029075, 71516084 and 41fc271b), all of which are dependsOn here. What remains is the lifecycle wiring and the environment identity, and its tests prove DoD 1-3 at the composition level. Plan against the LANDED bytes of CQ-R11 (task-07951125) and CQ-R11f (task-5b0a2bcf): runCheckJob with R11f's verify step. Use the landed exports of R11e1..e5 too, and re-read each before editing.

(a) scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs, R11d's E rows:
- Every checkEnvironment input fixture gains two keys:
  - toolchainSha256: 64 lowercase hex;
  - dependencyDigest: 64 lowercase hex, or null for a run with no dependency phase.
- E1 pins the two new CHECK_BOUNDARIES descriptors exactly, as listed in step 2.
- E3-style rows: toolchainSha256 alone, and dependencyDigest alone (including null versus a digest), each give a different identity.
- Each of these refuses with CHECK_INPUT_INVALID:
  - either key missing, or an extra key;
  - an uppercase, short or non-hex value, or a String object;
  - dependencyDigest as undefined or ''.
- A new row covers evidenceStatus:
  - an observation recorded under toolchain A, against a current record under toolchain B, with every other freshness field equal, is 'stale';
  - the same holds for the dependency digest;
  - identical inputs stay 'fresh'.

(b) scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs, R11's CJ rows:
- checkHarness gains four injected steps, each a recording fake:
  - toolchain resolves a frozen TOOLCHAIN = {file, sha256, size, version};
  - dependencies resolves a frozen CACHE = {tree: {entries: [], digest: D}, digest: D, packages, bytes};
  - installToolchain and installDependencies resolve.
- identityOf gains toolchain (default TOOLCHAIN.sha256) and dependencies (default null).
- Every existing CJ input gains dependencies: []. CJ8's real provisionGuest row injects the four fakes too, so no test downloads Node or a registry tarball.
- CJ9: dependencies is required. Each of these refuses with CHECK_JOB_INPUT_INVALID before any ledger, provider or step call:
  - a missing key or a non-array;
  - 17 entries, or a duplicate;
  - '', an absolute path, a '..' segment or a backslash;
  - a dir whose package-lock.json is not in the merged snapshot view.
- CJ10 uses dependencies ['.', 'pkg'] and a snapshot whose overlay replaces pkg/package-lock.json.
  - The step order is provision, toolchain, dependencies, materialize, installToolchain, installDependencies, onReady, session, verify, remove.
  - toolchain gets {arch: the arch of readyGuest's image.source, cacheDir}.
  - dependencies gets {lockfiles: [{dir: '.', bytes}, {dir: 'pkg', bytes}], cpu: that arch, cacheDir}. The bytes are the MERGED view's: the overlay's, never the base's.
  - installToolchain gets {name, toolchain: TOOLCHAIN, provider}.
  - installDependencies gets {name, tree: CACHE.tree, provider}.
  - onReady and the result get checkEnvironment({...the image, supervisor and resources inputs, toolchainSha256: TOOLCHAIN.sha256, dependencyDigest: D}).
  - With dependencies [], neither dependencies nor installDependencies is called, and dependencyDigest is null.
- CJ11: each new step's failure stops the run before onReady and the session. The VM is still deleted, and the run resolves infra-failure with this failure:
  - toolchain rejecting {code:'TOOLCHAIN_X'} gives 'TOOLCHAIN_X'. Any other rejection gives 'CHECK_TOOLCHAIN_FAILED', as does a result whose sha256 is not 64 lowercase hex.
  - dependencies rejecting {code:'DEPENDENCY_X'} gives 'DEPENDENCY_X', else 'CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_FAILED'. A digest that is not hex, or differs from tree.digest, gives 'CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_FAILED'.
  - installToolchain rejecting {code:'TRANSFER_X'} gives 'TRANSFER_X', else 'CHECK_TOOLCHAIN_FAILED'.
  - installDependencies rejecting {code:'TRANSFER_X'} gives 'TRANSFER_X', else 'CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_FAILED'.
  - An abort fired inside each new step gives 'CHECK_ABORTED'.
- CJ12: a session resolving 'infra-failure' passes through as infra-failure with failure null. That is what the guest's DEPENDENCIES_FAILED (81) gives, never passed or code-failure.
- CJ7 is extended: a changed toolchain sha256, or a changed dependency digest, gives a new environment, and evidence observed in the old one is stale.

Run `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs`. The new and changed rows fail for the expected reason; every other row passes.

Error handling in the tests: assertions name fixed codes, never messages, and no row reaches the network or a real provider.

scripts/local-runner/check-evidence.mjs (R11d): the toolchain and dependency identity inputs.

- INPUT_KEYS becomes ['dependencyDigest', 'providerImageHash', 'resources', 'sourceImageSha256', 'supervisorSha256', 'toolchainSha256'].
- validatedInputs reads each value exactly once, as today.
  - toolchainSha256 must pass sha256Hex.
  - dependencyDigest must be null or pass sha256Hex.
  - The returned copy carries both.
- CHECK_BOUNDARIES gains two descriptors, which E1 pins:
  - filesystem.toolchain: { owner: 'root', writable: false, identity: 'host-pinned-sha256' };
  - dependencies: { source: 'host-offline-cache', integrity: 'lockfile-sha512', scripts: 'ignored', network: 'none', failure: 'infra-failure' }.
  - Leave resources alone: R11a's drift test pins CHECK_RLIMITS against it.
- ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX stays 'moe-local-vm-v1:'. The inputs changed, so every identity value changes anyway, and nothing parses the prefix.
- Update the module header and checkEnvironment's JSDoc to name both inputs and say why each is there:
  - the toolchain digest makes a toolchain change require new evidence (R11e DoD 3);
  - the dependency digest covers which lockfile dirs were installed, which treeSha alone does not.

Error handling: unchanged. Any bad value, or an accessor that throws, is CHECK_INPUT_INVALID with the fixed message.

scripts/local-runner/check-lifecycle.mjs (CQ-R11, with CQ-R11f's verify step). Edit its LANDED bytes.

Imports:
- fetchNodeToolchain from './toolchain-cache.mjs' (R11e1);
- buildDependencyCache from './dependency-cache.mjs' (R11e3);
- installToolchain and installDependencies from './snapshot-transfer.mjs' (R11e2 and R11e4);
- validateImportPath from './source-snapshot.mjs'.

Input:
- KEYS gains 'dependencies'. It is REQUIRED, so it is not added to OPTIONAL.
- parse() copies it exactly once:
  - an array of 0-16 unique strings, each either '.' or a path that validateImportPath returns unchanged;
  - for each dir, the merged entry 'package-lock.json' (for '.') or `${dir}/package-lock.json` must be in workspaceEntries(snapshot).entries;
  - keep o.lockfiles as a frozen [{dir, bytes}], where bytes is a copy of that entry's data.
- Anything else returns null, which is CHECK_JOB_INPUT_INVALID before any call.

Injected steps: runCheckJob's second argument gains toolchain = fetchNodeToolchain, dependencies = buildDependencyCache, installToolchain and installDependencies, beside provision, materialize, session, verify and remove.

In checkJob, after the readiness check and before checkEnvironment:
- toolchain = await steps.toolchain({ arch: guest.image?.source?.arch, cacheDir }):
  - a rejection is codeOf(error, /^TOOLCHAIN_[A-Z0-9_]{1,60}$/, 'CHECK_TOOLCHAIN_FAILED');
  - a result whose sha256 is not 64 lowercase hex is 'CHECK_TOOLCHAIN_FAILED'.
- When o.lockfiles is non-empty, cache = await steps.dependencies({ lockfiles: o.lockfiles, cpu: <the same arch>, cacheDir }):
  - a rejection is codeOf(error, /^DEPENDENCY_[A-Z0-9_]{1,60}$/, 'CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_FAILED');
  - a digest that is not hex, or differs from cache.tree?.digest, is 'CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_FAILED'.
- checkEnvironment also gets toolchainSha256: toolchain.sha256 and dependencyDigest: cache ? cache.digest : null.

After materialize and before ready():
- await steps.installToolchain({ name, toolchain, provider }). A rejection is codeOf(error, TRANSFER_CODE, 'CHECK_TOOLCHAIN_FAILED').
- When cache is set, await steps.installDependencies({ name, tree: cache.tree, provider }). A rejection is codeOf(error, TRANSFER_CODE, 'CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_FAILED').
- Pass neither one timeoutMs. Like materialize, each keeps its own transfer default, because a tree can outlast the 60 s call bound.

After each new step: `if (signal?.aborted) return 'CHECK_ABORTED'`.

The session's outcome passes through unchanged. The guest's DEPENDENCIES_FAILED (81) already arrives as 'infra-failure', because check-session.mjs reports any exit before hello, other than 79, that way.

Update the header and runCheckJob's JSDoc:
- the step order;
- the dependencies input, where [] means no dependency phase, as a deliberate caller choice;
- the new fallback codes CHECK_TOOLCHAIN_FAILED and CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_FAILED, and the passed-through TOOLCHAIN_, DEPENDENCY_ and TRANSFER_ prefixes.

Error handling:
- Every new call is wrapped in its own try/catch inside checkJob, like the existing steps. A rejection, or a malformed or null result (read with optional chaining), becomes a fixed code, and runCheckJob still deletes the VM before settling, with workspace 'unverified' unless R11f's verify ran.
- No message carries a path, a lockfile byte or upstream text.

VERIFY ONCE, fresh.

1. Run `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-agents.test.mjs`.
   - This is R11e's command plus local-runner-agents.test.mjs, matching CI's local-runner line.
   - On WSL, run it under env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="<nvm Node 24 bin>:/usr/bin:/bin", so Windows Node is never used.
   - It must exit 0. Its fresh command, exit code and output tail are complete_task's verification evidence.
2. `git diff --check -- scripts/local-runner/check-evidence.mjs scripts/local-runner/check-lifecycle.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs` is clean.
3. A read-only `git status --short` shows that this task changed only those four files. Never revert, stash, `git add -A` or commit a peer's or pre-existing dirty path.

Error handling: fix a failing row in code. Never weaken a test that pins a boundary, a code or the step order.

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, once, as the final step. Load adversarial-self-review. Read the diff of the four files as an attacker:
- Does any path reach the session with an environment that lacks the toolchain sha256, or before installToolchain resolved?
- Can any new step's rejection or malformed result escape checkJob, so runCheckJob rejects, or skips the delete?
- Is dependencies read more than once, so a getter or Proxy could swap it after validation? Are the lockfile bytes the merged view's, and copied?
- Is the arch the guest's verified image.source.arch, never the host's process.arch? A guest without a pinned arch must fail as CHECK_TOOLCHAIN_FAILED, never fall back to a default.
- Two concurrent runs share cacheDir. Confirm that R11e1's and R11e3's landed writers use an exclusive .part and an atomic rename, as their contracts say.
- Is huge input bounded? dirs are capped at 16, and validateImport caps the tree.
- Can a pass be recorded with no dependency phase for a check that needed one? Only when the caller passed [], and the JSDoc names that as the caller's choice.
- Would I be embarrassed if this shipped?
Fix any finding, then re-run step 4's command fresh before complete_task.

planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- runCheckJob (check-lifecycle.mjs) injects every step through its second argument, and maps each rejection with codeOf(error, PATTERN, fallback) inside checkJob; follow that for the four new steps.
- guest.image.source is guest-readiness.mjs pinnedSource's {arch, url, sha256}, and provisionGuest returns it as image.source.
- workspaceEntries(snapshot) in snapshot-transfer.mjs is the merged base+overlay view sealed by validateImport. Its entries carry data buffers.
- validateImportPath (source-snapshot.mjs:79) returns a portable relative path unchanged or throws; '.' needs its own case.
- In check-session.mjs outcomeOf, any supervisor exit before hello other than 79 is infra-failure, so R11e5's 81 needs no host change.
- check-evidence.mjs canonicalJson sorts keys at every depth, and null encodes as null.
- The R11 test helpers identityOf, readyGuest, stopped, ranWith and checkHarness are in local-runner.test.mjs (~3880-3906). R11d's E1-E4 are in local-runner-check.test.mjs.
planningNotes.risks:
- Assumed interfaces, taken from the sibling rows' descriptions and their contract comments:
  - fetchNodeToolchain({arch, cacheDir}) gives a frozen {file, sha256, size, version}, with TOOLCHAIN_* codes;
  - buildDependencyCache({lockfiles:[{dir, bytes}], cpu, cacheDir}) gives a frozen {tree, digest, packages, bytes} with digest === tree.digest, and DEPENDENCY_* codes;
  - installToolchain({name, toolchain, provider, timeoutMs}) and installDependencies({name, tree, provider, timeoutMs}) use TRANSFER_* codes;
  - R11e5's guest exit is 81.
  If a landed signature differs, adapt the call here and note it in the step note. Never reshape a producer from this row.
- R11f lands first and changes runCheckJob (verify) and its CJ rows. Re-read the landed bytes.
- Every existing CJ input needs dependencies: []. One that is missed shows up as CHECK_JOB_INPUT_INVALID.
- E1 pins CHECK_BOUNDARIES exactly, and R11a's drift test pins CHECK_RLIMITS, so the new descriptors stay out of resources.
- V04b receives environment through onReady. Every identity value changes with this row; no stored evidence exists while verified-local is unavailable.
- A check that lists packages/moe-claude-plugin stays infra-failure until that lockfile is regenerated. This is by design, not this row's bug.
